identity.title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][time] Make Chronosense consume trusted_time at startup

values.summary: Initialize and bind #5697, transplant source-only commit 059cd5a48 onto origin/main, run focused tests and strict Clippy, obtain exact review, and publish a ready PR closing #5697.

steps.action: Initialize and bind the #5697 branch/worktree from current origin/main
Transplant source/test semantics from commit 059cd5a48 without #5663 lifecycle files
Run focused assembly and governed-operation tests plus strict all-target Clippy
Run exact-head review and fix actionable findings
Publish one ready PR with Closes #5697

invariants: trusted_time remains the qualified clock authority
Chronosense does not call SystemTime directly in production execution
Control/readiness dependencies are metadata dependencies, not fabricated OperationResult inputs
risks: Current main may have drifted around Runtime v3 assembly or operation factory signatures
The source-only transplant could accidentally carry stale #5663 lifecycle material if paths are not constrained
Startup-order proof could pass without proving immediate Chronosense adjacency if assertions are too weak
stop_conditions: Any typed claim collision on protected source paths
Any need to mutate #5663 lifecycle state or main checkout files
Any failed focused proof, strict Clippy failure, or actionable exact-review finding
